text: This staff report recommends the installation of a westbound left turn prohibition between 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m., Monday to Friday and a northbound right turn prohibition between 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday at the intersection of Clonmore Drive and Queensbury Avenue. Currently, no prohibitions are in effect.

City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council prohibit westbound left turns from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m., Monday to Friday, at Clonmore Drive and Queensbury Avenue. 2. City Council prohibit northbound right turns from 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, at Queensbury Avenue and Clonmore Drive.
